name: Account Dashboard
summary: Passive labelled account-navigation overview composed from canonical Card, Link, and optional Button actions while targets own customer data, routes, authentication, sign-out, privacy, and lifecycle state.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native section labelled by the required visible greeting heading.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Required heading and optional account-level action grouping.

anatomy.name: greeting
anatomy.description: Non-empty visible contextual heading that labels the section; the target selects its rank.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned account-level action slot composed from semantic controls such as canonical Button.

anatomy.name: grid
anatomy.description: Native unordered destination list with one or more complete items; its grid presentation does not create a grid widget.

anatomy.name: card
anatomy.description: Native list item carrying canonical Card plus the Account Dashboard context hook.

anatomy.name: cardBody
anatomy.description: Canonical Card body containing the destination identity and supporting copy.

anatomy.name: cardIcon
anatomy.description: Optional passive decorative icon hidden when the visible title is text-complete.

anatomy.name: cardDescription
anatomy.description: Optional concise localized destination summary, omitted when blank.

anatomy.name: cardFooter
anatomy.description: Canonical Card footer containing the explicit destination Link.

anatomy.name: cardLink
anatomy.description: Required native canonical Link with a non-empty descriptive label and target-owned href.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One passive account-navigation overview without a public visual variant.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic container-responsive profile; track count is private composition rather than a public size.

states.name: default
states.description: Valid rendering with a non-empty greeting and at least one complete destination.

states.name: actionsOmitted
states.description: The optional action wrapper is absent and the required greeting remains the section label.

states.name: singleDestination
states.description: A valid one-item list retains native list semantics and does not stretch into a distinct public mode.

states.name: containerTracks
states.description: The private grid changes from one to two to three tracks according to Account Dashboard container width.

states.name: dependencyInteraction
states.description: Canonical Card and Link own hover, focus, pointer, motion, forced-color, and reduced-motion treatment; U3 does not duplicate those states.

behavior.name: labelledRegion
behavior.description: The native section is named by its visible non-empty heading without an account-dashboard role or composite keyboard model.

behavior.name: nativeDestinationList
behavior.description: Destinations retain native list structure. CSS grid is presentation only, so role=grid and grid keyboard behavior are not added.

behavior.name: canonicalComposition
behavior.description: U3 consumes canonical Card, Link, and optional Button anatomy rather than duplicating their surfaces, focus styles, motion, or control behavior.

behavior.name: accountNavigation
behavior.description: Every destination is an explicit native Link with target-owned href and descriptive visible label. Whole-card activation is not inferred.

behavior.name: headerActions
behavior.description: Optional account actions preserve the semantics of the supplied target control. U3 does not turn sign-out, authentication, or commands into navigation.

behavior.name: targetLifecycle
behavior.description: Targets own customer records, authorization, route availability, pending/error/expired/empty state, action effects, privacy, focus, announcements, analytics, and redirection. Target-controlled views project that state through U3; platform-owned non-replaceable views use documented native handoff. U3 adds no neutral runtime or public state machine.

behavior.name: containerResponse
behavior.description: A named inline-size container selects private one, two, or three-track composition from actual available width rather than viewport width.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Short, long, localized, bidirectional, and unbroken content wraps without clipping or page-level horizontal overflow.

properties.name: greeting
properties.description: Non-empty visible customer-facing contextual heading that labels the section; targets select contextual heading rank and localized content.

properties.name: headerActions
properties.description: Optional complete target-owned account-level action composition, ordinarily using canonical Button for commands; omitted without an empty wrapper.

properties.name: cards
properties.description: Complete non-empty destination-list composition. Each native list item consumes canonical Card and contains a required native canonical Link; item count, order, copy, icons, routes, permissions, and data remain target-owned.

accessibility: Omit the complete renderer when the greeting is blank or the destination composition is absent, empty, duplicated by identifier, or incomplete; do not expose an unnamed or deceptive account shell.
Name the native section from its visible contextual heading with aria-labelledby and let the target select a heading rank that preserves the surrounding outline.
Use a native ul/li destination list. Do not add role=grid, arrow-key navigation, roving tabindex, a landmark role, or a custom keyboard model merely because CSS uses tracks.
Use one explicit native Link with a real target-owned href and descriptive visible label per destination; preserve Tab, Enter, modified activation, history, and canonical Link focus behavior.
Keep optional header commands semantically distinct from navigation and compose canonical Button where appropriate. The target owns working sign-out and other effects.
Hide decorative icons when titles carry the destination meaning, and do not rely on icon, position, color, hover, or the card surface alone to communicate purpose.
Protect account data and routes through target authentication and authorization. Do not expose sensitive summaries, unavailable destinations, or stale customer state merely to fill the grid.

Do not add a live region, automatic focus move, pending state, error state, empty state, or announcement owner to the passive U3 root; the target lifecycle coordinator owns qualifying dynamic feedback.
Allow long/localized and unbroken copy, narrow containers, 200 percent zoom, forced colors, reduced motion, and theme modes through logical sizing and canonical dependency behavior.

web.notes: Labelled native section/list composition implemented with canonical Card, Link, optional Button, named container response, zero U3 runtime, and target-owned data/actions.

shopify.notes: Shopify v1 themes use the controlled shopify-account sheet and hosted pages as an intentional native handoff with no parity claim. Target-controlled full-page extensions or headless storefronts may project U3 semantics with native components and Customer Account data. Classic Liquid is separately versioned compatibility; copied CSS is not a universal dashboard.

react.notes: Render target-owned destinations and actions through native dependency components; routing, auth, data, feedback, and lifecycle stay external.

figma.notes: Compose canonical Card, Link, and Button instances. Registered generic Button nodes are traceability metadata, not U3 artwork or visual approval.
